units.source_text: 提起传统，围棋也是从中国传来的。

en.t: Speaking of tradition, go was also brought over from China.

units.source_text: 不过，真正的围棋是在日本形成的。

en.t: However, go in its true form took shape in Japan.

units.source_text: 不论是现在还是三百年前，中国的棋艺同日本无法比拟。

en.t: Whether now or three hundred years ago, Chinese skill at the game could not compare with Japan's.

units.source_text: 围棋的高深是由日本人探索出来的。

en.t: The profundity of go was explored and brought out by the Japanese.

units.source_text: 这与昔日由中国传来的许多文明，在中国已经相当发达不同，围棋只有在日本才完全发展起来。

en.t: Unlike many forms of civilization that came from China in earlier times and were already quite developed there, go fully developed only in Japan.

units.source_text: 但那是在得到江户幕府的保护之后，是近代的事了。

en.t: But that came after it received the protection of the Edo shogunate, and belongs to the modern period.

units.source_text: 早在一千年前，围棋就传入日本。

en.t: Go had already been introduced to Japan as early as a thousand years ago.

units.source_text: 经过漫长的岁月，日本围棋的智慧也没有培植起来。

en.t: Even over the long passage of time, the wisdom of Japanese go had not yet been cultivated.

units.source_text: 据说，在中国，人们把围棋看成是超凡脱俗的游艺，

en.t: It is said that in China people regarded go as an elegant pastime beyond the ordinary world,

units.source_text: 充满了天地之元气，三百六十有一路中包含着天地自然和人生哲理。

en.t: filled with the primal energy of heaven and earth, with the truths of nature and the philosophy of life contained in its three hundred sixty-one lines.

units.source_text: 然而，开拓这种智慧之奥秘的正是日本。

en.t: Yet it was Japan that opened up the mysteries of this wisdom.

units.source_text: 日本的精神超过了模仿和引进。

en.t: The Japanese spirit went beyond imitation and importation.

units.source_text: 从围棋来看，这种情况很明显。

en.t: Seen through go, this situation is very clear.
